environment: isolated development C/V over USB loopback; synthetic front_b account

nativeAnimationSave.procedure: Realme system photo picker selected two synthetic images; app published a real two-image post, opened each original, and tapped 保存图片. Both returned 已保存到相册. MediaStore reported image/gif and image/webp in Pictures/original.*. Files pulled from the device match the uploaded files byte for byte.
nativeAnimationSave.appPlayback: PASS: repeated screenshots of the HnuHole original viewer changed for both GIF and WebP
nativeAnimationSave.systemGalleryPlayback: LIMITATION: ColorOS Gallery displayed a static first frame for both saved files in its ACTION_VIEW screen; the saved files retain all frames. Playback in this external app is outside HnuHole control.

profile.method: Profile-mode SchedulerBinding.addTimingsCallback, plus SurfaceFlinger latency for the Flutter SurfaceView. The latter retains only the latest 127 presented frames per scenario. The profile-only callback prints frame durations and adds small instrumentation overhead.

animatedViewerGifWebp.note: Presented-frame gaps include intended 400ms animation cadence and idle time, so do not represent scrolling jank.

profile.finding: No sustained frame-budget failure in this short synthetic-device sample; one isolated over-budget build/raster frame appeared in each of three scenarios. Long-session memory pressure and real-photo-heavy feed remain unmeasured.

fix.problem: Profile APK aborted at startup because development CA and passkey RP were Debug-only.
fix.resolution: Permit development loopback CA/RP only in Debug or explicit AUTH_DEV_PROFILE=true Profile builds; production Release still rejects it and requires two distinct fixed loopback HTTPS origins.

deviceAfterTest: Restored signed daily acceptance APK 2026102303 with install -r -d; app launched to home with account data and synthetic post retained. Profile APK 2026102304 remains in local delivery directory.
scope: Development test environment and Realme only; not iOS, production, full module acceptance, or remote CI.
